hook: There's a reason rich kids start early
voiceover: There's a reason old money starts early. Two people each invest three hundred dollars a month until sixty-five. One starts at twenty-five. One starts at thirty-five. Same seven percent assumed return. The late starter puts in one hundred eight thousand. And ends near three hundred sixty-six thousand. The early starter puts in thirty-six thousand more. And ends near seven hundred eighty-seven thousand. More than double. Those first ten years do the heavy lifting. Comment WEALTH for the free calculator.
ctaText: I’ll DM you the free calculator
caption: $300/mo to 65 at an assumed 7%: start at 35 → ~$366K. Start at 25 → ~$787K. Ten years, more than double. Math, not a promise. Comment WEALTH for the calculator. I'm an AI character. Education only.
youtubeTitle: There's a Reason Rich Kids Start Investing Early
sources: Math: FV $300/mo, monthly compounding, 7%: 480 months = $787,444; 360 months = $365,991 (src/lib/compound.ts)
